description_en: Retrieves information about session clusters or running jobs through the Flink REST API. Note that this operation only supports retrieving information and does not support operating or managing session clusters and jobs
description_zh: 您可以使用flink rest api的方式来调用本接口，获取session集群或者运行作业的相关信息。注意本接口仅支持您获取相关信息，无法对session集群和作业进行操作或管理
kebab_example: aliyun ververica flink-api-proxy --workspace 'a14bd5d90a****' --namespace default-namespace --resource-type jobs --resource-id '5a27a3aa-c5b9-4dc1-8c86-be57d2d6****' --flink-api-path '/jobs/:4df35f8e54554b23bf7dcd38a151****/config' --region cn-hangzhou
name: FlinkApiProxy

parameters.help_en:
The type of the resource. Valid values:
  • jobs
  • sessionclusters
parameters.help_zh:
资源类型，支持以下类型：
  • jobs
  • sessionclusters
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource. If the resource type is jobs, use the job ID. If the resource type is sessionclusters, use the name of the session cluster
parameters.help_zh: 资源类型是jobs，则使用jobid；资源类型是sessionclusters，则使用session名称
parameters.name: resource_id

parameters.help_en: The path of the Flink REST API. For example, you can use /jobs/jobid/config to obtain the configuration information of the job corresponding to the job ID. For more information, see the Flink community REST API documentation (https://nightlies.apache.org/flink/flink-docs-release-1.19/zh/docs/ops/rest_api/)
parameters.help_zh: flink rest api路径。如/jobs/jobid/config可以获取jobid对应作业的配置信息，更多使用可查看flink社区 rest api文档 (https://nightlies.apache.org/flink/flink-docs-release-1.19/zh/docs/ops/rest_api/)
parameters.name: flink_api_path

schema.description_en: The return value of the Flink request
